cutoff_policy: A day-only SEC filing is usable from filed + 1 calendar day. No claim of first public disclosure or intraday timing.
scope: Project-authored structured metric queries, 8 issuers, FY2022-FY2024; no natural-language accuracy or investment-return claim.
independence: Gold selected from raw SEC companyfacts with literal rows and Fraction arithmetic; no product imports. Coordination separates heldout author from implementers, not a physical access barrier.
exposure_policy: Do not expose heldout cases or gold to implementation agents until first implementation freeze and first evaluation receipt.
